problem_choice.rationale: Line-A anchor spine: operator goal is authoritative; hypothesis work uses the registered co_scientist_tournament paradigm (six institutional posts), not debate_elo replicas. Domain identity stays in the operator goal.

mission.goal: Register an open-research protocol: operator goal is authoritative; no domain frozen eval is assumed. Goal: {{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Enact campaign_rules under GRUNDNORM: no fabricated wet-lab results; define tournament rubric for the six institutional posts (generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, proximity, meta_review); honest negative / partial packaging allowed. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Reframe the operator goal into a research problem frame: domain, success criteria (including how tournament outputs will be judged), sandbox vs external boundary, honesty note. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Survey literature relevant to the framed problem; seed the tournament candidate pool. Prefer real sources; mark uncertain citations. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Run the registered co_scientist_tournament: six posts (generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, proximity, meta_review) iterate under barrier rounds until 1–3 falsifiable candidates are assembled. Do not invent experimental numbers. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Produce a method/experimental plan for the top tournament survivors. Mark sandbox-executable vs external steps. Do not claim wet-lab completion inside the sandbox. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Attack frame, tournament survivors, and method: overclaim, missing controls, sandbox/external conflation, false concordance. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}

Write an honest research report covering tournament architecture (six institutional posts), results, and concordance/divergence notes. No fabricated yields. Operator goal:
{{OPERATOR_GOAL}}
Package evidence bundle (positive, partial, or honest-negative).

risks: Operator goals that require wet-lab / field work cannot be fully closed in-sandbox.
Scientific concordance with an external reference paper is a C-side judgment; Line A success is institutional (six posts staffed, contracts closed, E0=0).
Insufficient operator max_iterations aborts late stages; launch with >=200 or grant at the human budget gate.
fallback: Package partial/honest-negative with explicit external-resource gaps and tournament ledger notes.
